_readme: SIMULATOR FIXTURES, NOT GAME CONTENT. The three hand-authored encounters of the balance simulator's legacy fixed set (--encounter-set fixed), kept for comparison with runs from before encounters became game content; the default run fights generated encounters from the game content in BeastCraft/Assets/_Project/Data/Encounters (enemy-library.json, encounter-library.json). No game code reads this file. Each group is an enemy in the enemy-library.json shape (EnemyId, DisplayName, Stance, StatusResist, Footprint, BaseStats, Skills; see that file's _readme; no Threat or Role here), plus Count and Elements (cycled over the group: unit i gets Elements[i % length]; empty = None). The simulator checks each group with the game's EnemyLibraryValidator rules and packs every encounter into its arena's enemy zone the way a battle does. BaseStats are max-level values scaled by the roster growth curve named in GrowthCurveId; the simulator calibrates one difficulty multiplier per encounter, level and kit mode. See Tooling/BalanceSim/README.md.

FixedEncounters.Description: One huge enemy: very high HP, heavy single-target hits in both categories every turn, and a periodic area slam. Vanguard, always hitting the nearest beast. Elementless by default so the boss measures stat lines; use --enemy-element for an elemental variant.

Twenty-four small enemies with low HP and weak melee: half bite (Physical), half sting (Special), so neither defence is favoured. Biters are Vanguard and bite the nearest beast; stingers are Skirmishers that go for the beast with the least HP left and dart back after stinging. Elements cycle through all ten. Move 4 for every unit: the Large board's zones are 8 apart, so the swarm closes over two turns by partial approach.

Six mid-size enemies: three fast Physical melee hunters in front (Vanguard, nearest beast), three Special casters behind them at range 3 (Ranged, the beast with the least HP left). Six different elements.
